role: Gate: renders one scene directory under out/java/render with raster_render and compares the frame with the oracle's golden.png; fails when the per-channel mean absolute error or the count of pixels over 25 exceeds the scene's line in tests/render_budget.txt (a ratchet), or when a scene has no budget line; SKIP lines exclude a scene by name with a reason.
gpu: line 93, function main: getenv(TMPDIR) for the output frame path (harness only)
line 98: the rendered frame file is left on disk (unlink is commented out)
notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/render. Native calls: raster_render (csrc/engine/raster.h), png_read_rgba (pngread.h). Depends on the GUI rgba assets built from the client jar (csrc/Makefile line 67). The Java list is the vanilla frame path the golden comes from; this test checks only the pixel budget, not individual Java members. Scenes include out/java/render/beach, beach6, beach8, blockicons_* and more.
